caseTitles: wrong-account invitation reveals only current account and supports logout before login
invitation expired is terminal without acceptance writes
invitation revoked is terminal without acceptance writes
acceptance lost ACK preserves intent and opens freshly verified invited Store
frozen v1 Analyze source context uses actual evidence and validates custom identifiers without guessing a provider
020 multiple history corrections gate every Review entry; closing evidence leaves pending and commit loss freezes confirmed rows
decline success: separate confirmation and N18-first recovery
decline failure: separate confirmation and N18-first recovery
decline lost-declined: separate confirmation and N18-first recovery
decline lost-pending: separate confirmation and N18-first recovery
Owner permission approve: current grant fence and explicit subset
Owner permission reject: current grant fence and explicit subset
Owner permission stale: current grant fence and explicit subset
Owner permission unknown: current grant fence and explicit subset
retained discovery availability=true: GET-only download without create
retained discovery availability=false: GET-only download without create
N9 distinct creator/Store creation/forecast filters preserve URL state and paging
Staff submits catalog-backed request, observes pending and can cancel with fresh request CAS
retained exports empty/error can reread without ever creating a new export
N9 creator selection and load-more retain Store-local date and forecast filters together
browser.type: Controlled HTTP interception; no live backend mutation or persistence proof.
